abilities.name: KernelLord/pickysteve
abilities.description: 面向编程智能体的本地优先技能路由与上下文选择器——采用混合 BM25 + 向量检索（RRF 融合）、带校准阈值的交叉编码器重排以及 LLM 评估器来选取合适技能，随后为执行模型组装带有随机数边界的极简上下文包。内置 ONNX 提示词注入防护网，全面扫描传入请求及所有检索到的文档，采用故障闭锁（在 180 个红队载荷测试集上达到 100% 检出率/0 绕过）。默认完全运行在本地 Ollama（也支持任何兼容 OpenAI 的端点）。提供 MCP stdio 服务器或兼容 OpenAI 的代理形式；一键安装程序可接入 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Windsurf 等 18 款编程智能体。安装方式：`git clone` + `uv`（PyPI 包尚未发布）。采用 MIT 许可证。

zh.name: KernelLord/pickysteve
zh.description: 面向编程智能体的本地优先技能路由与上下文选择器——采用混合 BM25 + 向量检索（RRF 融合）、带校准阈值的交叉编码器重排以及 LLM 评估器来选取合适技能，随后为执行模型组装带有随机数边界的极简上下文包。内置 ONNX 提示词注入防护网，全面扫描传入请求及所有检索到的文档，采用故障闭锁（在 180 个红队载荷测试集上达到 100% 检出率/0 绕过）。默认完全运行在本地 Ollama（也支持任何兼容 OpenAI 的端点）。提供 MCP stdio 服务器或兼容 OpenAI 的代理形式；一键安装程序可接入 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Windsurf 等 18 款编程智能体。安装方式：`git clone` + `uv`（PyPI 包尚未发布）。采用 MIT 许可证。

en.name: KernelLord/pickysteve
en.description: Local-first skill router and context picker for coding agents — hybrid BM25 + embedding retrieval (RRF-fused), cross-encoder rerank with a calibrated floor, and an LLM judge select the right skill, then assemble a minimal, nonce-boundaried context bundle for the execution model. Built-in ONNX prompt-injection gate scans both the incoming request and every retrieved document, fail-closed (100% detection / 0 bypasses on a 180-payload red-team corpus). Runs entirely on local Ollama by default (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint also works). Ships as an MCP stdio server or an OpenAI-compatible proxy; one-command installer wires up 18 coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Windsurf. Install: `git clone` + `uv` (PyPI package not yet published). MIT.

en.name: krastranseu-lang/klyo-games-mcp
en.description: Publishes and manages HTML5 browser games on klyo games (games.klyo.pl) from an AI assistant: uploads a ZIP from disk through a one-hour upload-only ticket or takes a public ZIP URL, checks the package (size, missing files, third-party ads, malicious code), gives the game its own g-<name>.klyo.pl address, releases and rolls back versions, sets the catalogue cover and listing, reads live play stats and posts to the games community. Diagnostics return the files the game requested but the package lacks, JavaScript errors from a real browser preview in the order they occurred, and a fit check on four screens (phone portrait and landscape with touch, tablet, desktop). 21 tools; deleting a game is annotated destructiveHint. Remote and vendor-hosted, nothing to install. Transport: Streamable HTTP at https://panel.klyo.pl/mcp?profil=gry. Auth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration - no token to paste; signing in with Google or an email link creates the account on first use. Clients: Claude, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT (developer mode), Cursor, VS Code, opencode. Docs: https://games.klyo.pl/mcp/. Official MCP Registry: pl.klyo/games.

en.name: Kultranz
en.description: US salary, cost-of-living, and take-home-pay data from BLS, BEA, Census, and IRS 2026 releases. en.name: loophole tape
en.description: pump.fun launch risk data and Robinhood Chain (Pons V2) launch-curve data for agents, computed from the project's own chain capture. Compact pump.fun check with calibrated probabilities of a rug within 5 minutes (tokens under 30 s old) and of graduation, plus observed creator exits, bundle selling, holder concentration and buyer flow; launch, rug and graduation feeds; creator and wallet cards; Robinhood Chain launch and curve cards priced with the creator tax and fee on both legs. 23 tools: 8 free (`catalog`, `health`, `market_regime`, `sample_mint`, `radar`, `check_coverage`, `watchlist_updates`, `rhc_regime`) and 15 paid per call with x402 in USDC on Solana or Base, or USDG on Robinhood Chain ($0.001 `launches_since`, $0.005 `check_pumpfun_risk`, up to $0.025 per card, $5.00 per daily parquet dataset); an unpaid call to a paid tool returns the payment requirements, and a prepaid key (`buy_trial_key` $0.10, `buy_api_key` $2.00) then pays by `X-API-Key` header. Free REST: radar, samples, calibration tables (`/v1/calibration`) and a daily public track record (`/v1/track-record`). Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint: `https://api.loopholetape.com/mcp` (no auth, no account). Official MCP Registry id `io.github.gosadu/loophole-tape` (v0.6.1).

abilities.name: Meshnote
abilities.description: 作为编程智能体长期记忆的智能体维护型 Wiki。智能体在各个独立的主题“大脑”中编写并交叉链接纯 Markdown 页面（YAML frontmatter、`[[wikilinks]]`、BM25 检索、反向链接图谱），每个主题库都预置一份 `schema.md`，指导智能体如何维护该大脑。每次写入都会保留版本历史记录，支持查看与恢复，且磁盘存储格式为标准 Obsidian vault，确保笔记始终可读且易于导出。远程 Streamable HTTP 端点：`https://meshnote.io/mcp`。传输协议：`streamable-http`。认证：OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + 动态客户端注册，或 Bearer API 密钥。16 项工具：`list_projects`、`create_project`、`get_schema`、`get_index`、`list_pages`、`list_sources`、`read_page`、`read_source`、`search_wiki`、`get_backlinks`、`get_graph`、`write_page`、`list_page_history`、`restore_page`、`append_log`、`register_source`。支持客户端：Claude Code、Claude.ai、Cursor、Codex 及任何 Streamable-HTTP MCP 客户端。闭源；付费托管服务。

en.name: Meshnote
en.description: Agent-maintained wiki as long-term memory for coding agents. The agent writes and cross-links plain Markdown pages (YAML frontmatter, `[[wikilinks]]`, BM25 search, backlink graph) across separate per-topic "brains", each seeded with a `schema.md` that tells the agent how that brain should be maintained. Every write keeps version history you can list and restore, and the on-disk format is a valid Obsidian vault, so notes stay readable and exportable. Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint `https://meshnote.io/mcp`. Transport: `streamable-http`. Auth: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + Dynamic Client Registration, or a bearer API key. 16 tools: `list_projects`, `create_project`, `get_schema`, `get_index`, `list_pages`, `list_sources`, `read_page`, `read_source`, `search_wiki`, `get_backlinks`, `get_graph`, `write_page`, `list_page_history`, `restore_page`, `append_log`, `register_source`. Clients: Claude Code, Claude.ai, Cursor, Codex, any Streamable-HTTP MCP client. Closed source; paid hosted service.

abilities.name: MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff
abilities.description: 告知编程智能体 Python 库在其训练截止后变更的公共 API，避免其编写项目已废弃版本的代码。包含三个只读工具：`api_changes`（针对单个 PyPI 包，对比模型截止版本与锁定或最新版本；优先列出已删除或移走的名称、删除或新增的必填参数，随后是废弃警告，包含 diff 中已知的替代方案；`symbol` 可限定为即将使用的具体名称）、`project_changes`（分析 uv.lock、poetry.lock、pdm.lock、Pipfile.lock、requirements 或 pyproject.toml 中锁定的所有依赖，优先展示项目代码已调用的 API）和 `model_cutoff`。智能体只需传入自身模型 ID。基于包源码进行静态 griffe diff：不调用模型、无需 API 密钥、不执行任何包代码。安装命令：`uvx since-cutoff@latest mcp`；stdio 传输；无需鉴权。支持客户端：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Claude Desktop、Gemini CLI。Registry ID 为 `io.github.MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff`。MIT 协议。

zh.name: MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff
zh.description: 告知编程智能体 Python 库在其训练截止后变更的公共 API，避免其编写项目已废弃版本的代码。包含三个只读工具：`api_changes`（针对单个 PyPI 包，对比模型截止版本与锁定或最新版本；优先列出已删除或移走的名称、删除或新增的必填参数，随后是废弃警告，包含 diff 中已知的替代方案；`symbol` 可限定为即将使用的具体名称）、`project_changes`（分析 uv.lock、poetry.lock、pdm.lock、Pipfile.lock、requirements 或 pyproject.toml 中锁定的所有依赖，优先展示项目代码已调用的 API）和 `model_cutoff`。智能体只需传入自身模型 ID。基于包源码进行静态 griffe diff：不调用模型、无需 API 密钥、不执行任何包代码。安装命令：`uvx since-cutoff@latest mcp`；stdio 传输；无需鉴权。支持客户端：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Claude Desktop、Gemini CLI。Registry ID 为 `io.github.MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff`。MIT 协议。

en.name: MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff
en.description: Tells a coding agent which public APIs of a Python library changed after its own training cutoff, so it stops writing code for a library version the project no longer uses. Three read-only tools: `api_changes` (one PyPI package, from the release at the model's cutoff to the pinned or latest version; removed or moved names and removed or newly required parameters first, then deprecations, each with the replacement when the diff knows it; `symbol` narrows it to the names you are about to use), `project_changes` (every dependency pinned in a project's uv.lock, poetry.lock, pdm.lock, Pipfile.lock, requirements or pyproject.toml, starting with APIs the project's code already calls) and `model_cutoff`. The agent passes its own model id. Static griffe diff of package sources: no model calls, no API key, no package code executed. Install: `uvx since-cutoff@latest mcp`; stdio; no auth. Clients: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI. Registry id `io.github.MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff`. MIT.

abilities.name: Nano (XNO) 钱包
abilities.description: 基于本地 stdio 的 Nano (XNO) 钱包 MCP 服务器，仅依赖 Python 标准库。完整配置下包含工具：`create_address`、`validate_address`（经校验和检查，返回机器可读的原因）、`balance`、`receive` 和 `send`。`--profile receive-only` 模式完全不注册 `send`（返回 `-32601`），且在该安装环境下运行 `nano-wallet selfcheck --profile receive-only` 即可验证。在完整配置下，除非设置 `NANO_WALLET_ALLOW_SEND=1` 否则拒绝执行 `send`，并可绑定操作员签名的授权策略（总额上限、单笔上限、收款方白名单、过期时间）。密钥在本地生成且区块在本地签名；金额采用整型 raw 单位。安装：`pip install "git+https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-wallet-xno"`，然后运行 `mcp_server.py --profile receive-only`。MIT 协议。

zh.name: Nano (XNO) 钱包
zh.description: 基于本地 stdio 的 Nano (XNO) 钱包 MCP 服务器，仅依赖 Python 标准库。完整配置下包含工具：`create_address`、`validate_address`（经校验和检查，返回机器可读的原因）、`balance`、`receive` 和 `send`。`--profile receive-only` 模式完全不注册 `send`（返回 `-32601`），且在该安装环境下运行 `nano-wallet selfcheck --profile receive-only` 即可验证。在完整配置下，除非设置 `NANO_WALLET_ALLOW_SEND=1` 否则拒绝执行 `send`，并可绑定操作员签名的授权策略（总额上限、单笔上限、收款方白名单、过期时间）。密钥在本地生成且区块在本地签名；金额采用整型 raw 单位。安装：`pip install "git+https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-wallet-xno"`，然后运行 `mcp_server.py --profile receive-only`。MIT 协议。

en.name: nano-wallet-xno
en.description: Nano (XNO) wallet as a local stdio MCP server, Python standard library only. Tools: `create_address`, `validate_address` (checksum-checked, returns a machine-readable reason), `balance`, `receive`, and `send` in the full profile. `--profile receive-only` does not register `send` at all (`-32601`), and `nano-wallet selfcheck --profile receive-only` proves that on the install it runs on. In the full profile `send` is refused unless `NANO_WALLET_ALLOW_SEND=1`, and can be bound to an operator-signed mandate (total cap, per-payment max, payee allow-list, expiry). Keys are generated and blocks signed locally; amounts are integer raw. Install: `pip install "git+https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-wallet-xno"`, then run `mcp_server.py --profile receive-only`. MIT.
